title: Number of Lifts Installed at Pedestrian Overhead Bridges
what_it_is: Number of Lifts Installed at Pedestrian Overhead Bridges

sections.label: Pedestrian overhead bridges lift retrofitting
sections.summary: By end 2021, 77 pedestrian overhead bridges were retrofitted with lifts, including 26 in 2021 and four in 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: As of end 2021, a total of 77 pedestrian overhead bridges (POBs) have been retrofitted with lifts as part of LTA's lift retrofitting programme.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Of these, 26 and four POBs were retrofitted with lifts in 2021 and 2020 respectively.

sections.label: Phase 3 lift retrofitting
sections.summary: Phase 3, started in 2020, targets about 60 pedestrian overhead bridges near places like healthcare institutions, with remaining 30 lifts installed over three years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Phase 3 focuses on POBs near places, such as healthcare institutions, so that lifts installed will benefit a high number of seniors and commuters with mobility challenges.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: This phase, which started from 2020, will see around 60 POBs being retrofitted with lifts.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The remaining 30 lifts will be installed progressively over the next three years.

sections.label: Lift installation and maintenance costs
sections.summary: A pair of lifts at pedestrian overhead bridges could cost up to $4 million to install and about $40,000 yearly to maintain.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: At that time, we shared that a pair of lifts at POBs can cost up to $4 million for installation and about $40,000 a year to maintain.

sections.label: Reduced installation, higher maintenance costs
sections.summary: Installation now costs about $2 million to $3 million per pair of lifts, while maintenance rose to about $45,000, and LTA will explore cost-efficient ways.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Currently, I am happy to share that, with experience and technologies, we have been able to bring down the cost.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: So, it now costs about $2 million to $3 million to install a pair of lifts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Unfortunately, the maintenance has gone up from $40,000, as shared in 2018, to about $45,000 now, because of labour and other associated costs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: LTA will continue to explore more cost-efficient ways to provide barrier-free access at our POBs when we retrofit them.
